Direct drawing tools

Selection is the default: click a room or connection. Drag a room to move it, or any orange edge or corner to resize. Drag a door or passage along its shared wall. Hold Space or use middle-mouse drag for temporary pan. Release Space to return to selection. On touch screens, drag empty paper to pan and use two fingers on empty paper to zoom.

Hold C to connect: drag from one room into another, or tap two rooms. A green shared-wall preview shows a valid connection. Choose single door, double door or open passage in the always-visible Connections panel. Double doors have two leaves and a total clear width. Open passages have no door leaf.

Hold X to disconnect: click a connection, or drag between two connected rooms. Hold P to draw a room: drag a rectangle, snapped to 0.5 m with a 1 × 1 m minimum. Release C/X/P to return to selection. Releasing a key during a drag cancels the unfinished edit. Escape cancels and returns to selection. The tool buttons work for one action on touch screens.

Delete / Backspace removes the selected room or connection. Room deletion confirms how many connections will also be removed. Undo restores the entire change. Typing in fields never triggers drawing shortcuts.

Linked stairs move and resize together on every level in their stack; local transfer stairs stay local. Legacy misalignment is preserved until you explicitly edit that stack. Courtyard and Operations voids follow their source room and cannot be moved separately. Freight shafts retain their existing locks. Actual overlapping room areas are shown in red; intentional void/shaft cutouts are excluded. The lower-floor stack overlays each lower above-ground level at 10% opacity. Current floors are solid and mask the stack; real voids remain open. Basements show only lower basement levels. Toggle the stack in the view controls. Switching floors preserves your view. Stair flights, treads and landings are calculated from actual elevations; UP and DOWN routes are drawn separately. The stair inspector shows clear widths, risers and headroom checks. Required slab, services and ceiling cutouts remain design requirements; this is not a construction or runtime-traversal certification. V8 and V9 are floor-plan revisions only; the V7 Blender model is unchanged. Corridors are editable rooms too. Plan checks flag overlaps, detached doors and rooms without a route to a floor entrance.

Undo / redo: Ctrl or ⌘ Z / Shift Z. Arrow keys move a selected room 0.5 m. SVG export produces editable vector linework for Figma; JSON preserves the complete editable model.

V9 preserves the 408 m² garage, 280 m² boarded B1 wing and 80 m² boarded L1 suite. The garage is 8 m clear with its floor 4 m below the clean B1 lobby. A full transfer stair follows wash and gowning, while a separate stair reaches B2 artifact intake/decon. B2 and B3 move down as complete levels so no research room overlaps the garage. L0 has a dedicated main-stair landing and a corridor-facing freight door. Cargo, clean staff and dirty returns use deliberate paths. Open the vertical stack for occupied height, service clearance, slab depth and all datums. All older layouts and their saved device edits remain separate. Blank plan space is exterior or unexcavated rock.
